description: Read one accepted event by its returned deliveryId and hook delivery token. Poll after accept_hook_event to distinguish queued, retried and completed delivery. Signed observations attest relay attempts, not successful business processing by the receiver. No new delivery or payment.

deliveryId.description: Delivery identifier returned on event acceptance; acceptance does not mean delivered.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

token.description: Private delivery token returned by registration; authenticates event submission, delivery lookup and receipt verification for this hook.

name: get_hook_delivery
title: Get Hook Delivery
